blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) said Monday that the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) had subpoenaed more than 21 individuals to give statements and shed light on the Laos drug shipment investigation. “The CIDG has already subpoenaed more than 21, not necessarily involved directly, for them to hear their side, and to exercise their right to be heard,” said PNP spokesperson Col. Allen Co in a press briefing on Monday.
